chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from al-Ḥusayn ibn Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar, from his mother and the mother of Aḥmad ibn Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:

We were with Abū al-Ḥasan عليه السلام in the desert, and we were heading to Baghdad. So he said to us on Thursday, "Perform ghusl today for tomorrow—Friday—for water there tomorrow will be scarce." So we performed ghusl on Thursday for Friday.

key_terms.اغْتَسِلَا: Perform ghusl (ritual bath), addressed to two people.
key_terms.الْجُمُعَةِ: Friday, the day for which the ghusl was intended.
key_terms.الْمَاءَ: Water, whose scarcity is the reason mentioned for advancing the ghusl.
key_terms.بِالْبَادِيَةِ: In the desert or open land, indicating the travel setting.
key_terms.قَلِيلٌ: Scarce or limited, describing the expected amount of water.

ai.seo_question: Can one perform the Friday ghusl on Thursday if water may be unavailable on Friday?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that Abū al-Ḥasan عليه السلام instructed his companions to perform ghusl on Thursday in preparation for Friday because water would be scarce the next day. It indicates the permissibility of anticipating a recommended ritual act when access to water is expected to be limited.
